content.query:
select CONTACTID CONTACTID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT CONTACTID CONTACTID2, * FROM
EDS.CONTACTS_DIM WHERE CONTACTID='654607' 
UNION ALL
SELECT CONTACTID CONTACTID2, * FROM
EDS.CONTACTS_DIM WHERE CONTACTID='654668' 
UNION ALL
SELECT CONTACTID CONTACTID2, * FROM
EDS.CONTACTS_DIM WHERE CONTACTID='654767' 
UNION ALL
SELECT CONTACTID CONTACTID2, * FROM
EDS.CONTACTS_DIM WHERE CONTACTID='888888' ) temp order by CONTACTID, SCD_START_DATE
